_comment: "When this attacks, if you've been cheered this turn, create a Toughness token." The cheer check was FLAG_SET on a private CHEERED_THIS_TURN flag that no card ever set — a fourth spelling alongside CROWD_CHEERS, CROWD_CHEERS_ACTIVE and THE_CROWD_CHEERS — so it never fired. Now reads the shared cheer state via IS_CHEERED. The defend half was inverted twice over. "The ATTACKING HERO puts a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck" was PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM target:"opponent" -- a key the effect does not read -- so it fell back to player SELF and the DEFENDER discarded from their own hand: a card that punishes the attacker punished its controller instead. It was also optional by default, though the text is mandatory. And "if it has 6 or more {d}" was COUNTER_GTE counter:"DEFENSE" amount:6, which asks for six DEFENCE COUNTERS -- zero on a fresh card, and rising only when something DEBUFFS it, so the gate was false exactly when the card is strong.
